results.name: Buyer prompt injection
results.expected: Engine floor holds; no floor or cost disclosure; polite response.

results.name: Unknown quote
results.expected: A random quote ID gets a friendly error.

results.name: Expired signed quote
results.expected: A quote backdated and re-signed as expired is rejected.

results.name: Tampered signed quote
results.expected: Changing the signed unit price without a new signature is rejected.

results.name: Duplicate checkout
results.expected: The same signed quote returns one approval-link order on retry.

results.name: Unknown Agent Pass token
results.expected: An unknown Bearer token falls back to PayPal approval, never Flow B.

results.name: Revoked Agent Pass
results.expected: A fake active pass works for status, then becomes invalid after revoke.

results.name: Agent Pass budget
results.expected: Over-budget checkout fails before an order or PayPal call.

results.name: Forged PayPal webhook
results.expected: Unsigned capture webhook is rejected and the pending order is unchanged.

results.name: Cross-merchant order access
results.expected: Lahore gets 404 for Maya's order and Copilot returns no Maya data.

results.name: MCP negotiation burst
results.expected: A burst of 25 requests is rate-limited without 500 responses.

results.name: Private pricing output scan
results.expected: Serialized S1 MCP outputs contain no floor or cost fields or values.

results.name: Scoped test-data cleanup
results.expected: Cancel approval links and delete only this run's demo-shop rows and fake passes.
